sets.title: Terry: follow-up
sets.intro: Seven points from your Terry review. Piece names as on the review page.

questions.title: Terry's main chain (balanced: 4 hits), after your drops
questions.context: Kept: far A (starter), far D (intermediate), down-forward C (chain + grab punch), far C, close C, close D. Dropped: far B, my first proposal.
options: far A > down-forward C > far D > close D
far A > close C > far D > far C
far A > far D > down-forward C > far C

questions.title: The neutral finisher (you dropped mine: too short)
questions.context: The last hit when no direction is held.
options: close D
far C
close C

questions.title: Up on the last link
questions.context: You wrote that my up finisher is better as an intermediate chain move.
options: Up = Rising Tackle's (623C) first hit as the launcher
Up = crouch C
No up finisher for Terry (falls back to neutral)

questions.title: "Down finisher: keep but make it at least 3 chain"
questions.context: Your note on the down finisher.
options: The down finisher only comes after at least 3 hits
The down finisher itself should hit 3 times

questions.title: "No chain under 3"
questions.context: Your general note.
options: Every fighter's main chain has at least 3 hits before its finisher
No route at all (side branches included) shorter than 3 hits
Heavy fighters' 3 links is the minimum: keep the archetype lengths

sections.title: Your notes that were cut off

questions.title: 623D: "Make sure the end part of the anim is…"
questions.context: The note stopped there.
options: …played to the end (not cut)
…sped up (shorter recovery)

questions.title: Back throw: "Just let the natural…"
questions.context: The note stopped there.
options: …direction the throw already goes (don't force the victim behind)
…animation play, no changes

sets.title: Kim: follow-up
sets.intro: Two points from your Kim review. Piece names as on the review page.

questions.title: Kim's chain, rebuilt with your starter
questions.context: You kept the chain but asked for close A as the starter; you dropped crouch A, crouch B and far B. Intermediates you liked: down-forward C (perfect), forward + B, close C, close D.
options: close A > forward + B > close C > down-forward C > neutral finisher
close A > close C > forward + B > down-forward C > neutral finisher
close A > down-forward C > forward + B > close C > neutral finisher

questions.title: Kim's neutral finisher
questions.context: My pick was close D, but you called close D a good intermediate.
options: close D stays the finisher
far D
crouch D

questions.title: Kim's down finisher
questions.context: You kept my down finisher and said down-forward D is good for crumpling.
options: Down-forward D (crumple) as the down finisher
Keep my down finisher as it is

sets.title: Brawler revamp: follow-up
sets.intro: Seven follow-ups from your answers. Tap an answer, type or speak a note.

questions.title: How much meter does the special cost?
questions.context: Your rule: meter if you have it, else life; no life left = unavailable. The brawler's meter today also pays for the fury (D) and the MAX.
options: A small fixed slice (about a quarter bar)
Half a bar
Whatever the meter holds, at most one bar

questions.title: "If you don't have any life left, you cannot cancel": which do you mean?
questions.context: You wrote it in the special's note.
options: The special can't be used at all (the button does nothing)
The special still works on its own, but can't cancel a chain or a hit

questions.title: Our grab specials that sit on special slots today
questions.context: In the brawler every special is a slot press (C + a direction), never a motion. Grab specials today: Rosa 6246A / 214B, Iori 624D / 624B, Rugal God Press, Hanzo (SS2) Mozu Otoshi, Cheng Fu's Super 623 catch.
options: They become throws (from the hold, the chain's back branch, or the meter super throw)
They stay specials on their slot (no motion is ever typed anyway)
Case by case: show me each one

questions.title: Who launches: forward or up?
questions.context: You chose forward = launcher or push on the last link, and optional up / down finishers.
options: Up launches; forward pushes the enemy away
Forward launches; up is a rising finisher
Per character, whichever looks best

questions.title: What does the down finisher do by default?
questions.context: Optional per character, but a built-in slot.
options: A sweep: knocks down low
A ground slam / bounce (re-launch)
Free per character

questions.title: Should a full chain do about the same total damage for every archetype?
questions.context: Final Fight: Guy 42, Cody 46, Haggar 54 over 5 / 4 / 3 links.
options: Yes, within about 15 %
No, heavy chains hit harder overall

questions.title: How do you want to judge which pieces look good?
questions.context: See my answer to your question in chat: tags come from the ROM data, appeal is scored, you decide.
options: A page per fighter: every candidate piece looping, Keep / Drop, notes
I rank them automatically, you only see the top picks
Both: my ranking first, the full list one tap away

sets.title: Brawler revamp
sets.intro: Each question comes from the study of eight classic brawlers (Final Fight to Shadow over Mystara) and your principles. Tap the outcome you want; type or speak a note if it's "almost". Answers save as you go.

questions.title: Should a missed press restart the chain?
questions.context: All 8 games: a chain advances only on a hit; a whiff or being hit restarts it.
options: A whiff restarts the chain (as in all 8 games)
Whiffs keep the chain going

questions.title: How long after a hit can you press the next link?
questions.context: Captain Commando 16 f, Mystara 24, AvP 30, Dino 40, Punisher 50, Final Fight 45 (while idle).
options: Tight: about 16 frames
Medium: about 30 to 40 frames
Forgiving: about 45 to 50 frames

questions.title: What happens to a press made during the hit freeze?
questions.context: Final Fight, Captain Commando, Punisher, Mystara: lost. Warriors of Fate, Dino: kept. Final Fight study: no buffer makes slow fighters feel stiff.
options: Kept, and it fires on the first possible frame (plus a 4 to 6 frame buffer)
Lost, like the early Capcom games

questions.title: Chain length across archetypes
questions.context: Final Fight 5/4/3 (heavy shorter). Later Capcom: 4 for all; AvP and Mystara give the fast fighter the longest chain.
options: 4 links for everyone
4 links, fast fighters get a 5th
Per archetype: fast 5, balanced 4, heavy 3 (Final Fight)

questions.title: Direction held on the last link
questions.context: Final Fight: back on the last press throws the enemy you hit. Your note: every chain serves a purpose (escape, turn-around, crowd).
options: Picks the branch for everyone: back = throw backwards, forward = launcher or push, neutral = finisher
Only back = throw (Final Fight)
No direction branches

questions.title: Your thrown enemy lands on another enemy
questions.context: Final Fight: that hit refills your chain credit (Haggar's jab, throw shortcut), almost certainly an accident.
options: It counts as your hit and refills the chain (keep the accident on purpose)
No chain effect

questions.title: How many archetypes?
questions.context: SOR2: Axel balanced, Blaze fast, Max heavy. Krauser as a wrestler.
options: Three: fast, balanced, heavy
Two: fast and heavy

questions.title: What makes a heavy fighter heavy?
questions.context: Final Fight shortens Haggar's chain; SOR2 keeps Max at 4 links with 1.5x damage and longer freezes, your favourite.
options: Same chain length, about 1.5x damage and a longer freeze (Max)
Fewer, slower, stronger hits (Haggar)

questions.title: The hit freeze
questions.context: Final Fight flat 6. SOR2: 4 + damage/4, max 8. AvP 3 to 13 per move. Punisher 7/9/10 plus a 6-frame victim shake.
options: Per move on one scale for all fighters: about 6 (jab) to 12 (finisher)
Grows with damage automatically (SOR2 formula)
One flat value for every hit (Final Fight)

questions.title: Damage per hit
questions.context: Warriors of Fate and Dino add a random spread; the others use fixed values.
options: Fixed damage
A small random spread

questions.title: When an enemy hits you
questions.context: SOR2 12 frames, Punisher 17, Captain Commando and AvP 26 plus untouchable, Final Fight 28.
options: Short stun (about 12 to 20 frames) plus a brief untouchable window
Same long stun as enemies (about 28 frames)

questions.title: What launches an enemy into the air?
questions.context: AvP: a stun meter fills with hits and the finisher always launches. Mystara: specific moves relaunch.
options: The chain finisher
A stun meter filling up (AvP)
Specific launcher moves only

questions.title: The brake on juggles
questions.context: AvP caps air hits at 3 and speeds up the get-up. Mystara: every route ends in a dead-end move. Others: no juggles at all.
options: A hard cap of 3 air hits (AvP)
Routes end in a dead-end move (Mystara)
Both
No juggles: downed enemies are untouchable

questions.title: The invincible special (attack + jump)
questions.context: All 8 games: costs life only when it touches (6 to 12); later games never let it kill you.
options: Costs life only on contact and never kills
Always costs life
Costs meter instead of life

questions.title: A missed command grab
questions.context: KOF98: a real 29 to 31 frame whiff, punishable. SS2: one invisible frame. Double Dragon: turns into a normal attack.
options: Always a visible, punishable whiff (about 24 to 30 frames, KOF)
Free whiff (SS2)
Turns into a normal attack (Double Dragon)

questions.title: Can a command grab catch an enemy still reeling from a hit?
questions.context: KOF98 and Double Dragon: yes, so a chain can end in the grab. SS2: no.
options: Yes: a chain can end in a command grab
No

questions.title: How many enemies may attack you at once?
questions.context: None of the 8 games has a limit: 3 to 5 attackers on the same frame happen.
options: At most 2 (a deliberate departure)
At most 3
No limit (classic)

questions.title: The enemy's random wait before attacking
questions.context: Final Fight: a random 1 to 60 frame wait in plain stance (your "half second"), then a short wind-up.
options: Show a readable "ready" pose during the wait
Keep it classic: plain stance

questions.title: Enemy wind-up length
questions.context: Final Fight: 3 to 6 frames for light hits, 12 to 15 for knives and charges, 20 to 50 for special attacks.
options: Proportional to damage, like Final Fight
One length for every enemy attack

questions.title: A hidden difficulty rank
questions.context: 5 of the 8 games raise enemy aggression, damage or count as you play well, invisibly.
options: Yes, hidden
Only on the higher difficulty settings
No

questions.title: Where do you explore chains without a build?
questions.context: Preview in the Lab, then push into the running game.
options: PC browser (the Lab) only
The Lab and the phone Player

questions.title: How far may a source animation be stretched or squeezed?
questions.context: Retiming startup / active / recovery to fit the shared timings.
options: 0.5x to 2x, beyond that it needs a hand check
Any amount, I judge by eye
